g.text: Activate it — run these once (Kratos never runs systemctl for you)
systemd then owns the timing, reboot-survival, and catch-up. Test it any time with /schedule
# so the timer runs even when you're logged out
Ctrl+Y copies these commands exactly (don't select wrapped text).
Running schedule 'daily-audit' now (headless, approval-gated tools excluded)…
notified: no (notifications aren't set up: KRATOS_NTFY_TOPIC)
Saved trigger 'medium-alert': when severity ≥ medium → notify.
It's evaluated after every scheduled run (and after /run). Try it now with /trigger test.
